contract.eligibility_rule: Select only Candidates that supply source-exact content one required role demands. Selectable roles: subject, object, time, place, polarity, modality. Syntax attachment establishes availability, never eligibility.
complete_selected_set_rules: Exactly one eligible Candidate per required role the pool can represent; coordination may require multiple.
Overlapping Candidates reduce to the narrowest source-exact canonical boundary.
A Candidate is redundant only when it adds no required content beyond the canonical boundary.
Separate source occurrences stay distinct even when their text matches.
A select-all answer fails when the pool holds ineligible or redundant Candidates.
contract.none_rule: A justified NONE means the task is complete and no eligible Candidate exists. An observed NONE is an abstention judged against the expected eligible set, never assumed justified.
canonical_boundary_rules: The canonical boundary is the narrowest source-exact span containing the role's argument head and all content the role requires, and no content a different role requires.
A Candidate equal to the canonical boundary is not redundant because a larger Candidate contains it.

signal_definitions.name: composition_readiness
signal_definitions.not_applicable_when: the reference selected set or composition inputs are absent
